name: hr-eval
description: Evaluate developer candidates by observing how they think with an AI agent. Logs every prompt, tool call, and edit during an interview session, then produces a structured report against 7 signals of developer thinking (promptcraft, critical reception, verification, debugging methodology, architecture steering, environment & tooling, metacognition). HR generates job-specific tasks + profile from a JD; candidate runs /eval-start to begin a transparent, logged session; /eval-report produces the analysis.
